_about: Public-domain Robert Elliott Speer (1867-1947), secretary of the Presbyterian Board of Foreign Missions, for the Word Hoard: his books printed before 1930, among them Studies of the Man Christ Jesus (1896), Studies of the Man Paul (1900), Missionary Principles and Practice (1902), The Principles of Jesus (1902), Missions and Modern History (2 vols., 1904), The Marks of a Man (1907), Christianity and the Nations (1910), The Light of the World (1911), John's Gospel the Greatest Book in the World (1915), Race and Race Relations (1924), Seeking the Mind of Christ (1926) and his memoirs of missionaries and friends. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 78 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
